papers.title: Ti-6Al-4V Additively Manufactured by Selective Laser Melting with Superior Mechanical Properties
papers.first_author_affiliation: Centre for Additive Manufacturing, School of Aerospace, Mechanical and Manufacturing Engineering, RMIT University, Melbourne, VIC, 3001, Australia

corresponding_authors.name: Wei Xu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Centre for Additive Manufacturing, School of Aerospace, Mechanical and Manufacturing Engineering, RMIT University, Melbourne, VIC, 3001, Australia

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了选区激光熔化Ti-6Al-4V的力学性能，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或表面形貌等生物医学植入物关键指标。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on mechanical properties of SLM Ti-6Al-4V without addressing porous structures for stress shielding mitigation, fatigue behavior specifically for implants, or surface roughness for osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索选区激光熔化Ti-6Al-4V获得优异力学性能的工艺条件。
summary_zh.method: 通过工艺参数优化制备Ti-6Al-4V试样并进行拉伸等力学测试。
summary_zh.result: 优化参数下材料具有高强度和高延展性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过标准力学试验验证了材料性能。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the process parameters for achieving superior mechanical properties in Ti-6Al-4V fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Ti-6Al-4V samples were fabricated via SLM with optimized process parameters and subjected to tensile testing.
summary_en.result: The optimized parameters yielded high strength and ductility in the as-built material.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical properties were validated through standard tensile and hardness tests.

papers.title: Vitamin-E diffused highly cross-linked polyethylene liner compared to standard liners in total hip arthroplasty. A randomized, controlled trial
papers.first_author_affiliation: Division of Orthopaedics, Department of Clinical Sciences at Danderyd Hospital, Karolinska Institutet, Stockholm, Sweden

corresponding_authors.name: Mats Salemyr
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Division of Orthopaedics, Department of Clinical Sciences at Danderyd Hospital, Karolinska Institutet, Stockholm, Sweden

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文为临床随机对照试验，比较不同髋臼内衬的磨损性能，未涉及股骨柄应力遮挡或有限元分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical trial on liner wear, with no quantification of femoral stress shielding, micromotion, or any FEA boundary conditions.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较维生素E扩散高交联聚乙烯与传统内衬的临床效果。
summary_zh.method: 随机对照试验，纳入THA患者，比较两种内衬的磨损率。
summary_zh.result: 维生素E内衬可能减少磨损，但临床差异有限。
summary_zh.validation: 基于患者随访的临床验证。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the clinical performance of vitamin-E diffused highly cross-linked polyethylene liners with standard liners in total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A randomized controlled trial was conducted, enrolling patients undergoing THA and comparing liner wear rates.
summary_en.result: Vitamin-E liners showed potentially reduced wear, but clinical differences were limited.
summary_en.validation: Clinical validation through patient follow-up and radiographic analysis.
